**Download `PulseSetup` below and run it** to install Pulse (no administrator password needed).
Works on any 64-bit Windows 10 or 11 PC.

## Pulse 1.2.7
<!-- x: quiet -->

**Fixes**
- The intro plays every time Pulse opens, in Gaming and Ultra-low modes too, and a slow start can't cut it short.

**New**
- No lyrics for a song? An **Open on Genius** button takes you straight to it on Genius, and songs with lyrics have a **See them on Genius** link.
- Other people's profiles and public playlists have an **Open on the website** button.

## Pulse 1.2.6
<!-- x: quiet -->

**Fixes**
- Song covers no longer go missing after clicking around. Covers that fail to load are tried again, and the covers on the page you're looking at load first.

## Pulse 1.2.5
<!-- x: skip -->

**Fixes**
- Songs with swearing now play the uncensored version when **Explicit songs** is on. Some songs used to play the clean version because it looked identical on YouTube; Pulse now checks YouTube Music's explicit label.
- Artist pages no longer mix in other artists with the same name. Deezer files some artists (like "Che") together with dozens of namesakes; their releases now sit in a separate **Other artists named …** section you can open.

**Better imports**
- Songs that aren't on Deezer now get their real length, explicit label and every credited artist from TIDAL, so they play the right version too.

## Pulse 1.2.4
<!-- x: Songs start faster, profile pictures everyone can see, and one tidy profile page. P.S. not every theme shows up in Settings 👀 -->

**New**
- **Profile pictures others can see.** Set one on your profile while signed in and it shows on your public profile, in the app and on the website.
- **One profile page.** The picture in the top corner and Settings → Your profile now open the same page, with your link, bio and public playlists.

**Faster**
- Songs start faster: Pulse gets a song ready when you hover over it, so it's usually playing within a second of your click.

**Fixes**
- The early-supporters thank-you list in Settings no longer breaks names letter by letter.

## Pulse 1.2.3
<!-- x: A glow-up for the Founders theme our first 100 members get: gold trim, gold titles and a gold play button. Thank you for being here early. -->

A small update for early supporters:
- The **Founders** theme got a glow-up: gold trim around the sidebar, cards and player, gold page titles, a gold play button and richer colors.
- In Settings → Themes it now reads **Founders – Early Support**.

## Pulse 1.2.2
<!-- x: Choose explicit or clean versions of songs, a Get Pulse button on your Discord status, and a gold Founders theme as a thank-you to our first 100 members. -->

**Fixes**
- Songs no longer play the censored version by surprise. A new **Explicit songs** switch in Settings → Playback picks the uncensored version (on) or the clean one (off).
- Settings now says what it does: Pulse checks for updates each time it opens.

**New**
- A **Get Pulse** button on your Discord status, so friends who see what you're listening to can get it too.
- **Early supporters:** the first 100 Pulse accounts get the gold **Founders** theme, an ★ Early supporter badge on their profile, and their name in a thank-you list in Settings.

## Pulse 1.2.1
<!-- x: Imported playlists now play the real song (no more covers, karaoke or 30-second clips), featured artists stay put, and search puts the most popular version first. -->

**Songs play the right version**
- Imported playlists no longer pick covers, karaoke copies, instrumentals, remixes, live or sped-up versions, unless the song's title asks for one.
- When the catalog doesn't have the original (it happens with some big hits), the song is imported as it is and played from YouTube by its real artist, instead of a lookalike.
- Featured artists stay on imported songs ("Ride Wit Me" with City Spud).
- Playback prefers the song's own album audio over the music video, and skips 30-second clips.
- Songs the catalog only lists as a 30-second clip ("Firework") play in full and show their real length.

**Better search**
- The most popular version of a song comes first, with duplicate versions folded into one.
- Searching for an artist and a song shows that artist's songs, not tributes and piano covers.

**Also new**
- **Report a problem** in Settings and on the Diagnostics page sends a report straight to the developer, and a crash offers to send one too.
- Pulse checks for updates every time it opens and asks if you'd like to update.

## Pulse 1.2

**A better first launch**
- A short intro with its own beat every time you open Pulse, followed by a quick "Welcome back, @you" once you've opened it before.
- **Pick artists you like:** choose a few (browse by genre or search) and your home page fills with "Listeners of … also listen to" and "Songs like …" rows built from them. You can skip it.
- Those rows now show above "Top songs right now".

**Accounts**
- Sign in on the website too (the person button at the top right): edit your bio, email and password, make playlists private, or delete your account. New accounts are still made in the app.
- A Privacy Policy, linked from the website, the docs and the sign-up window.
- Password reset emails say roughly where the request came from, so you can tell if it wasn't you.

**Discord status**
- Works with **Legcord** and **Vesktop**: turn on Rich Presence (arRPC) in their settings. Settings says so when Discord isn't found.
- Pulse retries when Discord is briefly busy, and shows Windows' own error if something else gets in the way.

The 1.1 changes are in the [1.1.0 release notes](https://github.com/mercy123xz/Pulse/releases/tag/v1.1.0).
